# Sheun & Sheun Automation
> Automate Smarter. Scale Faster. | Enterprise AI Automation & Shopify Platform Engineering

## Overview
Sheun operates two specialized technical divisions under the same domain (https://sheun.online):

1. **Sheun Automation Division** (https://sheun.online/automation)
Focuses on AI workflow automation, GoHighLevel CRM setup, conversational AI chatbots, sub-600ms AI voice agents, Business Process Automation (BPA), CRM migrations, email marketing sequences, and custom API/n8n middleware engineering.

2. **Sheun Shopify Division** (https://sheun.online/services)
Focuses on high-converting Shopify store development, custom Liquid theme design, WooCommerce to Shopify migration, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and e-commerce SEO.

## Sheun Automation Services
- **AI Workflow Automation**: Self-executing AI pipelines powered by GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Flash for document parsing, lead routing, and database execution. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/ai-workflow-automation)
- **GoHighLevel CRM Setup & Automation**: Complete GHL customization, sub-600ms speed-to-lead SMS/Email nurture flows, missed-call text-back, and booking calendars. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/gohighlevel-crm)
- **AI Chatbot Development**: RAG-trained conversational AI bots deployed across Website, WhatsApp, and Slack with function-calling capabilities. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/ai-chatbots)
- **AI Voice Agent & Calling Solutions**: Human-sounding AI voice callers for 24/7 inbound scheduling and outbound speed-to-lead verification. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/ai-voice-agents)
- **Business Process Automation**: Enterprise operational re-engineering across finance, HR, inventory, and procurement. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/business-process-automation)
- **CRM Integration & Migration**: Zero-loss data migrations between Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Zoho with bi-directional webhooks. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/crm-integration)
- **Email & Marketing Automation**: Behavioral lifecycle email and SMS sequences in Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, and GoHighLevel. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/email-marketing-automation)
- **Custom API & Middleware**: Custom REST/GraphQL webhooks, serverless microservices, and self-hosted n8n enterprise workflow servers. (https://sheun.online/automation/services/custom-api-n8n-zapier)
